working_definition: Capa (Capability/periviscerokinin/pyrokinin family) neuropeptide-expressing neurosecretory neurons from Davie et al. 2018's adult whole-brain atlas (73 cells), recovered independently at both the neuropeptide-subclustering (Figure 2K) and res-8.0 (cluster 119) levels. Defining markers include Capa plus general neurosecretory/peptide-processing genes (7B2, amon, Phm, IA-2, Pdi). Because the dataset profiles brain only (no VNC), this most likely represents a brain-resident Capa+ neurosecretory population rather than the classic VNC/abdominal-ganglion Capa (Va) neurons described in the wider literature.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any neuron that is part of some adult nervous system and is capable of some peptide hormone secretion and expresses Capa (FBgn0039722).

justification: This FBbt term's defining criteria (adult nervous system, peptide-hormone-secreting, expresses Capa) match the cluster's defining marker and neurosecretory character exactly, and critically it is not restricted to the VNC/abdominal-ganglion 'Va neuron' subtype - it covers any adult Capa-expressing neuron anywhere in the nervous system, including the brain. This resolves the report's own brain-vs-VNC caveat: the general adult Capability neuron term is the correct level for a brain-resident Capa+ population, since the more specific classic 'Va neuron' terms are VNC/abdominal-ganglion-restricted and would not apply to whole-brain-derived cells.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Larval Va neurosecretory neuron expressing Capa, classically located in the abdominal ganglion.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Wrong developmental stage (larval) and wrong body region (VNC/abdominal ganglion); this atlas profiles adult whole brains only, and the report notes VNC-restricted Capa/Va neurons would not be represented.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Adult Capability neuron located in the subesophageal zone.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Overly specific location restriction (SEZ only) not established by the report, which does not localise the cluster within the brain.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Any neuron capable of peptide hormone secretion that expresses Capa.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Stage-unqualified parent of the chosen adult-specific term; the adult variant is more precise and equally applicable here.

recommendation: High-confidence exact match at the general adult Capa-neuron level; the report's brain-vs-VNC caveat is resolved by this term's lack of VNC restriction, so no further narrowing or new term is needed.
